entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: All right, that was a great performance[n]by the dance club!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Everybody give them another[n]round of applause!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...My apologies for being so distracted.[n]I can't stop thinking about Akechi-kun...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are we really no match for him...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're right. What's done is done.[n]We should enjoy ourselves for the[n]time being.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... I don't want to lose.

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: And now, it's time for your[n]favorite Shujin tradition:[n]the Student Sharing Special!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This event is never very popular.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The older teachers seem to enjoy it[n]for some reason though...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: All right, who has something to say?[n]Anyone, anyone!?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: No? I'll just have to pick someone then!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, he's choosing from the crowd?[n]The MC this year is actually somewhat[n]capable.

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Oooh, is that our lovely student[n]council president over there!?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Come on up here, Miss Prez!
Are you going to ignore him?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not really the proper use[n]for that phrase...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Here she is: everyone's favorite student[n]council president, Makoto Niijima-san!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: So, with the Kamoshida scandal,[n]Principal Kobayakawa's passing,[n]and even that Hawaii trip...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: I'd be surprised if you've had any time[n]to study for your entrance exams!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Now then, on with the show![n]What would you like to share[n]with us today, Miss President?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I... don't really have anything to say...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Here, I'll give you a question...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Do you think the Phantom Thieves[n]are really Shujin students?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: We're all dying to know what[n]Akechi-kun was going to say about[n]their true identities.

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Some people theorize that they go[n]to our very school...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: So, are they from Shujin? What do you[n]think, Miss President?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: I'd love to hear the answer too!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Now this is drama! A boy caught[n]in the throes of bittersweet youth![n]A stunning confession of love!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Sooo, Miss President! What's your[n]relation to this guy?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: My, she's red as a beet!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: A rare glimpse into the girly side[n]of our stunning Miss President!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: But I'm a gentleman. It hurts my heart[n]to bully such a sweet girl!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Well, did you all enjoy our[n]blushing beauty? Thank you[n]very much, Miss President!
